thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — Nimbus Bank POC kicks off tomorrow. CTO requested SAML SSO + SCIM + delegated admin support. They also want domain proofing options and clarification on SCIM delta performance. Can SE/security weigh in?

sam: For SCIM: we support bulk sync + delta. For large orgs recommend initial bulk CSV import then delta for day-to-day. Need to confirm rate limits for hosted vs dedicated.

jules-sec: Security note: customer asks for SAML metadata import, cert rotation window, and group->RBAC assertion mapping. We support metadata upload and certificate rotation endpoints. We should capture their expected rotation cadence (90d?) and whether they want automated JWK rotation.

kevin-ae: Pricing question from procurement: if they run the POC on Hosted but later commit to Dedicated, can we apply the POC credits to the first Dedicated invoice? Also they asked whether SCIM API calls count toward token/API billing.

sam: Short answer: POC credits can be applied to first month of Dedicated commit but need finance sign-off (we've done this for a few customers). SCIM calls are metered as API calls (not token generation). I'll confirm exact metric names.

maria: Ops question from Nimbus: they want domain allowlist for tenant creation and proof of domain ownership. Do we support TXT/MX DNS verification or SCIM-based verification?

jules-sec: We support TXT DNS proofing (recommended) and SAML assertion-based domain verification for some flows. We do NOT use SCIM as primary domain proofing. Also they requested a dataflow diagram for Private/VPC deployment and audit log export details. @ops-bot can you attach the VPC dataflow template?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: attached: https://redwood.example/pkgs/redwood-vpc-dataflow.pdf — includes HSM/KMS integration notes and audit log retention options.

sam: RBAC mapping: we support mapping via SAML group attributes or SCIM groups. Recommend 3 roles for POC: admin, dev, read-only. Example SCIM mapping payload (simplified):

```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"],"displayName":"eng","members":[{"value":"user-123","display":"alice@example.com"}]}
```

Use externalId or group.displayName -> role_* convention for automatic mapping.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll send them the mapping example and the POC checklist. They asked about SCIM throughput — initial sync for ~50k users. Any benchmarks?

sam: For 50k initial sync: best to do bulk CSV import to seed users, then use SCIM delta. On Hosted we can request a temporary rate limit bump (we've allowed up to ~200 req/s for deltas during POCs); Dedicated gives predictable throughput and capacity. I'll pull concrete numbers from infra and post.

jules-sec: Security questionnaire items they care about: SOC2 Type II, encryption at rest (AES-256), in-transit TLS1.2+, KMS/HSM options, SAML assertion replay protection, and audit exports for provisioning events. We have templates for these answers. They also asked about SAML attribute minimization and PII handling — we'll need to include our data retention and deletion flow.

kevin-ae: Next steps: I'll loop in procurement/legal this afternoon. Maria can you draft a one-pager POC success criteria (SSO successful, SCIM delta within target RPS, RBAC mapping validated, audit logs delivered)? Include expected timeline and support windows.

maria: On it. Sam/Jules — can you review the one-pager before EOD?

sam: Reviewing now. Small item: if they want Just-In-Time provisioning via SAML, confirm supported attributes: email, given_name, family_name, groups. Also clarify whether we provision user metadata from SAML or SCIM preferred source of truth.

jules-sec: Confirmed. JIT supported with those attributes. Security prefers SCIM as source-of-truth for group membership and long-term provisioning; JIT ok for initial session creation. Also flag: they will enforce MFA at IdP — document recommended handling for service accounts.

maria: Thanks — I'll incorporate. If legal/finance blockers appear, flag here and I'll escalate.

kevin-ae: FYI procurement asked about SLA for Dedicated (latency and uptime) and whether we can include a penalty clause for critical issues during onboarding. We usually negotiate SLA addendums for enterprise.

maria: Noted. I'll add a line item for SLA discussion and proposed timeline for Dedicated negotiations.

sam: I'll follow up with infra for SCIM throughput numbers and sample mapping snippets.

jules-sec: I'll prep security questionnaire answers and the dataflow diagram attachments.

maria: Great. I'll post the one-pager + sample mapping in #sales-pocs and ping Nimbus IT. Thanks everyone.

kevin-ae: thanks all.

sam: roger.

jules-sec: thanks.
